name: get_gene_info
description: Fetch detailed information about a specific gene using its gene symbol. Returns the gene's name, organism, function, and associated pathways. Use this tool when you have a specific gene symbol (e.g. 'TP53'). Do NOT use this tool for searching genes by other criteria (e.g. gene ID or keyword); use 'search_genes_by_criteria' for that.

parameters.name: gene_symbol
parameters.description: The official gene symbol representing the gene of interest, typically consisting of uppercase letters (e.g. 'TP53'). Must be a valid gene symbol recognized in the relevant database.

parameters.name: include_pathways
parameters.description: Whether to include associated biological pathways in the response. Set to false to reduce response size if pathways are not needed. Defaults to true.

organism.description: Scientific name of the organism where the gene is found (e.g. 'Homo sapiens').

function.description: Description of the gene's biological function.

pathways.description: List of biological pathways associated with the gene. Only present if include_pathways=true.

return_schema.description: Gene metadata including symbol, name, organism, function, and optional pathways.
